requirements.objective: Freeze interfaces, constraints, manufacturer assumptions and exact part/footprint choices before implementation.

electrical.objective: Build and review atopile electrical intent, then create the immutable physical-input freeze.

physical.objective: Create an origin-proven KiCad candidate and a functionally correct, routable placement.
required_evidence: critical footprint and rule-area integrity at physical origin
placement routability comparison and critical route probes

routing.objective: Classify and route critical paths first, then create and audit batched low-risk KRT candidates.
required_evidence: unchanged-placement receipt or fresh placement semantics
checkpoint visual review per functional block
notes: In the four-layer template, In1.Cu and In2.Cu are planes; ordinary signal routing uses the outer layers.
Use explicit trace plans for short two-endpoint local routes, and asynchronous start/status/finalize checkpoints for long KRT runs.
Fast copper preflight and routing-order checks reject bad candidates early but never replace exact KiCad DRC and connectivity.
Three consecutive rejected candidates in one route area trigger diagnosis without automatically returning to placement.
forbidden: counting tool/audit/DRC failures as no-path topology failures
moving footprints directly from a routing failure without an escalation and improved placement evidence

release.objective: Run exact-board electrical, physical and manufacturing gates and export a reproducible package.
required_evidence: fresh release readiness has no blockers
release review packet and separate explicit visual assessment
critical footprint rule-area equivalence bound to the exact board
DFM order parameters and required PCB/SMT modules match the reviewed order profile
compiled manufacturing registry passes for the exact Gerber package
all configured special manufacturing processes have evidence-bound confirmations
